title.en: Woods and Valleys of Mount Yu

dimensions.en: Image: 37 1/4 x 14 1/8 in. (94.6 x 35.9 cm); Overall with mounting: 82 x 20 5/8 in. (208.3 x 52.4 cm); Overall with knobs: 82 x 24 5/8 in. (208.3 x 62.5 cm)

credit_line.en: Ex coll.: C. C. Wang Family, Gift of The Dillon Fund, 1973

intro.zh: 倪瓒是元末四大家之一，这幅画作于1372年，那时他已近晚年。他的山水以简淡著称：近岸几棵树，中间一大片空白的水面，远处是低缓的山。画中没有人。这种宁静和空旷，被看作画家心境高洁的表现。
intro.en: Ni Zan, one of the Four Great Masters of the late Yuan dynasty, painted this in 1372, near the end of his life. His landscapes are famously spare: a near shore with a few trees, a wide stretch of empty water, and low hills beyond. There are no people. The calm and emptiness were read as a sign of the painter's purity of mind.

look_for.zh: 干而淡的墨色：倪瓒用墨极少，几乎不用渲染。
look_for.en: The dry, pale ink: Ni Zan used very little ink and almost no wash.

look_for.zh: 三段式的布局：近岸、空水、远山。
look_for.en: The three-part plan: near shore, empty water, distant hills.

look_for.zh: 留白：画面上很大一部分是没有落笔的纸。
look_for.en: The bare space: a large part of the picture is untouched paper.

alt.zh: 一幅窄高的淡墨立轴：近景岩石上有几棵细树，中间是空白的水面，上方是圆缓的山丘。
alt.en: A tall, narrow hanging scroll in pale grey ink: a few thin trees on rocks in the foreground, empty water, and rounded hills at the top.
